description: Type the replayed operation id on updateDdl (HTTP 409 ALREADY_EXISTS: 'Operation ID already exists: ...'). A caller that names its DDL operation to make it idempotent replays the same id after a crash and needs to tell that apart from a concurrent schema change, which also surfaces as 409 Conflict.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: A DDL operation with this operation_id already exists on the database (HTTP 409 ALREADY_EXISTS: 'Operation ID already exists'). Read `{database}/operations/{operation_id}` for its outcome.
